skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the historical development of economies in various countries and Vietnam through different periods.
Analyze, explain, and evaluate economic phenomena, events, and processes in the historical development of economies in various countries and Vietnam.
Identify recurring patterns and draw lessons from the historical development of economies in various countries and Vietnam.
Develop skills for collecting, analyzing, and reporting economic data.
Develop independent research skills, teamwork, and presentation skills through writing, discussion, and presenting topics on the economic history of various countries and Vietnam.
Enhance self-learning abilities and research capabilities to improve knowledge about the economic history of various countries and Vietnam.
Enhance critical thinking abilities to critique economic issues based on knowledge and lessons learned from practical research on the economic development of various countries.
Enhance awareness, responsibility, and professional ethics in making personal judgments and evaluations of specialized issues.
